newsitem.title: UK: IBM weak in Europe on profit warning talk.
newsitem.headline: IBM weak in Europe on profit warning talk.

text.p: Shares in the U.S. computer giant IBM were trading at $156, down $2 from New York's official close of $158 on rumours that the company could be on the verge of issuing a profits warning.
"No one seems to know where the profits warning has come from but it has spread all around Europe. Some people are saying the company could issue a warning as early as today," one market maker said.
"Trading has come to a virtual halt in IBM. Very few want to stick their necks out if this rumour turns out to be true," one senior dealer said.
IBM, which reached a high of $161-7/8 on Tuesday in New York after news of Monday's stronger-than-expected book-to-bill ratio, lost $2 in Wall Street's final 22 minutes of trade.
